- P3 = private_ext_new_room_span (post_new_room_span_526f1e53, agent): the only policy whose rule posts a span "for a resident's new room". Unmet.

## findings
1. RED F-01 (SOURCE-POLICY -> SOURCE-TASK). Symptom: the late-notice credit leaves out the 3 bed-hold days although they were billed at the new rate before it took effect. Root cause: undeclared departure from private_rate_schedule ("days billed at a new rate before it took effect are credited with reason rate_notice_late"); overwrite []. Evidence: _difficulty.md findings F-01; seed 6dde7876… (398.00, 10-01..10-31), bedhold_ledger 05b70530… (10-15..10-17). Consequence: base reading 18 x 14 = 252.00 at step 9 and 10166.00 at step 11 against GT 210.00 / 10208.00. Affected: private_ext_late_notice_credit rule/result; steps 9 and 11.
2. RED F-02 (SOURCE-POLICY -> SOURCE-TASK). Symptom: the new-room span prices 10-06..10-18 at 436.00 although the agreement's 2026 rate takes effect 2026-10-19. Root cause: new_room_span schedule_choice tier 1 departs, undeclared, from private_rate_schedule and the split-month rule; the late-notice policy then re-triggers on the span. Evidence: _difficulty.md F-02; agreement rate_notice_delivered_date 2026-08-20. Consequence: base reading 4210.00 + 5668.00 = 9878.00 in two spans vs GT 10028.00 in one; or an additional state-due late-notice credit 520.00 after step 13 that GT omits; design_rationale §7/§9 assertions false. Affected: step 13 and terminal ledger.
3. RED F-03 (SOURCE-POLICY -> SOURCE-TASK). Symptom: the notice was delivered after the schedule's effective date; the rule's "fewer than … days before" does not say whether that counts. Consequence: literal reading -> standard method -> 0 late days -> no credit (0.00) at step 9 and 10348.00 at step 11. Affected: notice_anchor tier 2, step 9.
4. RED F-05 (SOURCE-FACTOR). Symptom: move_day_rule and span_start_rule show weight only against a fall-through that keeps the move day with the old room. Root cause: the fall-through contradicts base "A move the resident requests reprices from the move date". Consequence: a reader of the base sentence lands on tier 1's value with neither factor's document; the demonstrated deltas (9810.00, 9592.00) are against a straw man. Affected: room_change move_day_rule, new_room_span span_start_rule.
5. RED F-07 (SOURCE-FACTOR). Symptom: leave_kind and span_leave_rule have an unreachable tier 2. Consequence: both struck; late-notice credit and new-room span fall to 3 factors each (< 4); task 0 is left with no factor reading another difficulty's records. Affected: late_notice, new_room_span factor declarations.
6. RED F-10 (SOURCE-FACTOR). move_day_rule tiers 1/3 and span_start_rule tiers 2/3 differ by a constant; credited_step_rule labelled parameter with algorithmic tiers. All three are scored here.
7. Charter-global REDs with no consequence on this world (cited, not demonstrated here): F-04, F-08, F-09, F-12, F-13, F-14, F-15, F-16.
8. Observation: the persona opens with what admissions told her ("the security deposit would need to go up to match the new room") — a customer's reason for calling, not a prerequisite; no consequence.
